heading: Application for Graduate Product Engineer Opportunities 2027
paragraphs: I am applying for the Graduate Product Engineer Opportunities 2027 in Belfast. The programme's focus on building scalable applications across the full technology stack, combined with structured training in AI literacy and professional skills, is exactly the environment I am looking for as a graduate. Allstate's reputation as a product-driven, cloud-first organisation makes this a place where I can contribute meaningfully while developing my engineering capabilities.

My academic background has given me a strong foundation in both security and software development. My Master's in Information Security at Royal Holloway included modules in cryptography, secure business architectures and digital forensics, while my BCA covered Python, Java, JavaScript, C++, MySQL and AI & ML. In my IT support role I manage access requests through Active Directory, investigate suspicious emails and serve as the first point of contact for 15 employees across 15-20 devices. This has taught me to communicate technical issues clearly and to document work so others can follow it.

My projects demonstrate my ability to build and evaluate software. I designed a phishing analysis prototype that mapped suspicious email indicators to MITRE ATT&CK techniques and evaluated it against a mixture of suspicious and legitimate emails, with every output left for a human to validate. I also built a Chrome extension using 25+ detection patterns to warn users about potential exposure of sensitive data, tested at 93.7% accuracy across 150+ manual test cases. These projects taught me to think about edge cases, to test systematically and to iterate based on evidence rather than assumption.

I want to be straightforward about where I would be starting. My professional programming experience is with Python and PowerShell, and my knowledge of production engineering tools is from academic study rather than professional work. What I do bring is a solid understanding of programming fundamentals, a methodical approach to testing and documentation, and the ability to learn new technologies quickly. I am confident I can contribute to an Agile team from day one while developing the specific skills the programme requires.
I would welcome the chance to discuss the role further. My CV is attached, and I am happy to answer any questions about my experience or my projects.
